config.description: Set to 'true' to expose eia_dataframe_drop for manual canvas cleanup. Also requires CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE=duckdb.

config.description: Cumulative row ceiling for eia_query_route DataCanvas staging on a stage: true call. Five requests at EIA's 5000-row-per-request ceiling.

config.label: Facet values eia_describe_route returns per facet before truncating
config.description: Facet values eia_describe_route returns per facet before truncating. Page past it with the tool's facet and values_offset inputs.

config.label: Set to 'duckdb' to enable DataCanvas (Node
config.description: Set to 'duckdb' to enable DataCanvas (Node.js only). Registers the three eia_dataframe_* tools and lets eia_query_route stage rows when called with stage: true.
